title: Maximum Subarray Sum After One Operation
summary: Given an integer array nums, you must replace exactly one element nums[i] with nums[i] * nums[i].
statement: Given an integer array nums, you must replace exactly one element nums[i] with nums[i] * nums[i]. Return the maximum possible sum of any non-empty subarray after performing this operation exactly once.
constraints: Choose exactly one array element and replace it by its square, then choose a nonempty contiguous subarray.
Return the maximum possible subarray sum.
hints: A best subarray ending here either has not used the square or has used it exactly once.
Track the best ordinary ending sum and transformed ending sum.
Update transformed from square alone, previous plain plus square, or previous transformed plus value.
These are the exhaustive positions of the one squared element relative to the subarray ending here.
editorial: These are the exhaustive positions of the one squared element relative to the subarray ending here.

tests.explanation: Squaring negative four and taking [2,-1,16] produces seventeen.
Squaring either one changes nothing; the best contiguous sum is three.
